decision: MSS builds and native acceptance do not depend on CWG, its dispatcher, credentials, model service or check-broker binary. Equivalent MSS-native security/evidence qualification remains mandatory.
mss_keeps: project-local goals, test catalog, evidence and unchanged Toolkit contracts

independent_verification_gate.title: Independent MSS native verification and evidence authority
acceptance: Owner-approved physical Windows/toolchain/dependency profile; no containers, WSL/WSLC, VMs or user-desktop input.
Exact immutable source and executable identity; source/worker/output/credential authority separated under the applicable threat model.
Independent authenticated source-bound evidence; a hash, compile or command acknowledgement alone is not a verified result.
Native negative file/network/process/cleanup checks on the actual MSS profile; mock proofs or broker success are not substituted.
Untrusted generated code, build.rs and dependency hooks are not executed before their native boundary is qualified. Trusted fixed-fixture experiments need separate explicit admission.
Full unchanged Toolkit operations/schema/scenarios and all native positive/negative/teardown tests remain required. No unavailable operation is counted as PASS.
New exact-SHA reports with independent owner review; no activation, merge, self-VERIFIED, credentials or paid calls authorized by this document.

conditional_backend_gates.rule: Any reuse of a private-desktop or shared-surface mechanism retains its real association/cleanup/security gates. Not applicable must be justified by the reviewed backend design, not used to remove Toolkit requirements.

independent_verification_gate.cwg_requirement: NONE; an optional external verifier must meet the same contract and does not confer acceptance by name.

historical_sources.handling: Project GOAL data stays MSS; reusable automatic routing/workflow belongs CWG.
